q: By June 30, 2027, NATO or the U.S. government and Russia officially announce the restoration of a military-to-military hotline or an agreement to prevent accidental clashes covering Europe or the Baltic region
basis: The 2025 U.S. National Security Strategy lists reestablishing strategic stability with Russia among its priorities. In a diplomatic document reported by Reuters on September 30, 2026, however, Russia escalated its nuclear threats. Risk-reduction mechanisms are likely to be discussed together with a ceasefire in Ukraine.
rs: Announcements by NATO, the U.S. government or the Russian Ministry of Defense
